Definition: Kanah, the name of a stream and of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Kanah is both a river and a town: the border went out to the river Kanah, the coast descended unto the river Kanah southward of the river. The town of Kanah stood in Asher's inheritance, even unto great Zidon.
TheologicalSignificance: I take the double naming as the mark of a real place, a river that drew a border and a town that bore its name.
